resources.string: Yearly subscription that removes banner ads
Removes the banner ads from Futeba dos Parças. The app stays the same, just without ads.
You are ad-free. Thank you for supporting Futeba dos Parças.

1-year subscription that renews automatically at the same price. You are charged to your Google Play account when you confirm, and again every year until you cancel. To cancel, open Play Store, Payments and subscriptions, Subscriptions, at least 1 day before the renewal. No card data goes through the app.
The subscription is not available right now. Check your internet and Google Play account and try again later.
Payment pending. When it is confirmed, the ads go away on their own.
The subscription was not completed. Try again later.
